tasks.label: Build firmware (Keil)
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $log = 'vscode_build.log'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $log) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $log }; $build = Start-Process -FilePath 'D:/keilc/arm/UV4/UV4.exe' -ArgumentList @('-b', 'Firmware.uvprojx', '-o', $log) -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location).Path -Wait -PassThru; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $log)) { Write-Error 'Keil did not create a build log'; exit 1 }; Get-Content -LiteralPath $log; if ($build.ExitCode -ne 0 -or -not (Select-String -LiteralPath $log -Pattern ' - 0 Error\(s\),' -Quiet)) { exit 1 }
